description: This file defines a custom Swing component called HorizontalLine that extends JPanel. It overrides paint method to draw a horizontal line centered within the component, and specifies minimum and preferred sizes.

classes.name: HorizontalLine
classes.description: A custom Swing component that displays a horizontal line centered within its area.

methods.name: paint
methods.description: Overrides the JPanel paint method to draw a black horizontal line centered vertically.

methods.name: getMinimumSize
methods.description: Returns the minimum size of the component (150x10).

methods.name: getPreferredSize
methods.description: Returns the preferred size of the component, same as minimum size.
